title: Completed Training Plan and Log Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Training Plan and Log artifact data payloads (PMO-04.11.02).

target_audience.description: The specific stakeholder group, department, or role that requires training to effectively operate new systems or execute updated workflows.

training_module.description: The title, core learning objectives, and curriculum content designed to build required technical and operational competencies.

delivery_method.description: The instructional format and medium used (e.g., in-person workshop, live virtual session, self-paced e-learning, or peer coaching).

target_date.description: The scheduled delivery date or completion deadline, aligned with project deployment and user readiness milestones.

completion_status.description: The current progress or adoption status (e.g., Scheduled, In Progress, Completed) tracking user participation and certification.
